text:
ashley: Quick UX check — playing with the invoke helper panel in the playground. noticed a couple of weird flows when a function schema is long and the run history is open.
jamal: Yup saw that too. Specifically? I only hit it on narrow widths.
ashley: On narrow screens the helper panel overlays the run history which makes it hard to copy structured outputs. Also the helper title 'Args' feels terse.
elaine: Agree on 'Args' — suggest 'Input schema' or 'Function inputs' for clarity and a11y. 'Args' might confuse non-dev users.
mike: +1 'Function inputs' is better. Also keyboard trap: when tabbing through run history then opening the helper, focus stays in the history and helper isn't announced by VO.
ashley: Repro steps I used:

1) open playground
2) click function def -> open helper panel
3) click a history entry -> helper loses focus

We should add a focus trap and an aria-live announcement like: "Function inputs panel opened".
jamal: For copy: the CTA currently says `Copy` but it copies JSON with no formatting. Should be `Copy JSON` or provide options `Copy` / `Copy pretty`.
elaine: We should show a tiny toast that says "Copied JSON" and include a button to toggle pretty copy. For power users maybe `cmd+shift+C` to copy pretty.
mike: UI nit: helper panel header has an icon + badge that says "beta" — badge color contrast fails 3:1. Needs darker text or different background.
ashley: Good catch. I'll file a contrast task. Also the function param preview renders as a single line for long descriptions. Can we clamp but offer an expand chevron? e.g., show 2 lines + `Show more`.
jamal: For run history, when a tool call returns structured output, we currently render the object collapsed and the 'Open in helper' button is small. Proposal: inline a micro-preview of top-level keys (like `title:`, `id:`) so you can scan without opening helper.
elaine: Love that. Minimal: show up to 3 keys, separated by middots, low-contrast text, clickable to open full view.
mike: Also add a small keyboard shortcut row under the helper header: `Esc` = close, `C` = copy, `P` = prettify. Might conflict but we can namespace with `g` prefix later.
ashley: Copy suggestion for the helper header copy: current "Function inputs" -> change to "Function inputs (schema)" — makes it explicit it's a schema not runtime values.
jamal: One more: tool-call logs sometimes include internal keys like `_meta`. We should hide keys starting with underscore by default and show a toggle "show hidden fields".
elaine: Accessibility: make sure the toggle is focusable and has aria-pressed. And announce counts: "Showing 3 of 7 fields".
devex-bot: reminder: UX sync at 2pm today (kanban: https://redwood.example/board/ux). Please bring examples.
ashley: I'll mock a tiny prototype with the micro-preview + pretty copy toggle. Posting a screenshot in the thread shortly.
jamal: If you can include a small snippet for the micro-preview rendering, here's what I mean:

```
// render preview
preview = Object.entries(obj)
  .filter(([k]) => !k.startsWith('_'))
  .slice(0,3)
  .map(([k,v]) => `${k}: ${shorten(v)}`)
  .join(' · ')
```

mike: That code looks good. Ensure `shorten` avoids breaking JSON strings mid-word and shows an ellipsis.
ashley: Awesome. I'll iterate and post a prototype before the 2pm sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
